name: Icon
source:
The age of sword fights. 
Two countries enjoy a brief moment of peace. Two swordsmen have appeared in the smallest country at such time. The turbulent times approach, so they need to protect their motherland and learn about the true nature of conflict...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
剑斗的时代。
两个国家正享受短暂的和平。此时，两名剑士现身于其中较小的国家。动荡的时代正在逼近，他们必须守护祖国，并了解冲突的真相……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
